name: eurollm-22b
about: EuroLLM-22B-Instruct (2512), from the EU-funded EuroLLM project (Unbabel, Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Edinburgh and partners). Apache-2.0. 22.6B dense, Llama architecture, BF16 as released, 45 GB: fits an A100 without FP8. Trained for all EU languages, not for SQL. Default settings: nothing in its card asks for more.
